config.scope: Prespecified focused replication at 50% removal: both real and quaternion families, mapfold/pruned/direct policies, seeds 2027 and 2028, same fit/check/validation split and recipe as discovery. Report 2026 separately as discovery and both new seeds individually. This is not an independent data-split or dataset replication. No official-test evaluation, no post-outcome selection or hyperparameter sweep.
config.resume: Per-site atomic compact checkpoint and records. STOP checked between sites and after repair batches; abrupt interruption repeats at most one site or partial epoch. Repair saves full optimizer/scaler/RNG per completed epoch. Final epoch3, no selection.
